function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS chunk_count
FROM documents d
JOIN embeddings e ON d.id = e.document_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY chunk_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
